in_hebrew.name: Tobin
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is good
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tobin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew Tobiah, meaning 'God is good'. In the Old Testament, Tobiah was a nobleman who helped the prophet Haggai rebuild the Temple. A name of strong faith and kindness.

in_greek.name: Tobin
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is good
in_greek.long_meaning: Tobin είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew Tobiah, meaning 'God is good'. In the Old Testament, Tobiah was a nobleman who helped the prophet Haggai rebuild the Temple. A name of strong faith and kindness.

in_latin.name: Tobin
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God is good
in_latin.long_meaning: Tobin est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew Tobiah, meaning 'God is good'. In the Old Testament, Tobiah was a nobleman who helped the prophet Haggai rebuild the Temple. A name of strong faith and kindness.
